summary.en: Chinese militia boats are expanding battlefield preparation in the western Pacific while the Chinese coast guard monitors Philippine resupply missions to the grounded BRP Sierra Madre at Ayungin Shoal. The Philippine Coast Guard rescued 20 people off Basilan and opened an upgraded station on Pag-asa Island, but two Coast Guard personnel were killed in a shooting in Cotabato City. Taiwan is offering cooperation to protect undersea cables, and an ex-NSA urged activation of the Philippines-China coast guard agreement. The DND chief warned that any Chinese attempt to tow the BRP Sierra Madre would be an act of war. 176 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesiske militærbåter utvider forberedelser til kamp i det vestlige Stillehavet mens den kinesiske kystvakten overvåker filippinske forsyningsoppdrag til den strandede BRP Sierra Madre ved Ayungin-revet. Filippinernes kystvakt reddet 20 personer utenfor Basilan og åpnet en oppgradert stasjon på Pag-asa-øya, men to kystvaktsoldater ble drept i en skyting i Cotabato City. Taiwan tilbyr samarbeid for å beskytte undersjøiske kabler, og en tidligere NSA oppfordret til aktivering av avtalen mellom Filippinene og Kina om kystvakten. DND-sjefen advarte om at ethvert kinesisk forsøk på å tau til BRP Sierra Madre ville være en krigshandling. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
